_comment: Hearthbound: soulslike-weaponry-1.4.9-1.20.1-fabric.jar hardcodes this structure's biomes as an INLINE list, so no datapack tag merge can reach it — it generated ONLY in minecraft:savanna, minecraft:plains, in RU territory as much as in BWG's. Full-file override, identical to stock except the biomes list. stock is the literal pair savanna + plains — extended to the RU and BWG plains and savanna analogues that a #minecraft:is_savanna / plains tag reference would already have reached. Re-derive from the jar with .claude/tools/gen-inline-structure-overrides.js if the mod updates.
